According to the conversation between Wolfgang and LiHua on September 5, 2026, Wolfgang expresses feeling under a significant amount of pressure due to the demands of a new software project he is working on. He conveys his emotional state through a metaphor, describing himself as being in a "pressure cooker," which vividly illustrates the intense and overwhelming nature of his work situation. LiHua empathizes with Wolfgang, acknowledging the pressure while simultaneously offering support and encouragement. She reminds him of his talents and encourages him to break down the work into manageable steps, assuring him that the feeling of being overwhelmed is temporary. Wolfgang's anticipation for the upcoming jam session with LiHua is noted as a much-needed relief and an opportunity to relieve some of the stress caused by his workload, highlighting the importance of their musical collaboration as a stress-relief and support mechanism.

> WolfgangSchulz: Hey man, this new software project is really pushing me to my limits. I feel like I’m constantly in a pressure cooker. 😩
> LiHua: I totally hear you, dude. Just remember, this pressure won’t last forever. You're super talented, and I believe in you! Just take it one step at a time. 💪✨

In this particular exchange, it is clear that Wolfgang's conversation with LiHua not only touches on his professional challenges but also underscores the significance of their jam sessions in providing a respite from work-related tension. Their upcoming musical gathering is framed as not just a recreational activity but also as an emotional and motivational boost.
